single_change: Move rival selection out of the planner. The planner emits exactly one field, intent, while the deterministic executor chooses and continues any tactical target.
hypothesis: An intent-only planner will retain strategic adaptation without scattering physical force across model-selected rivals. Executor-owned target continuity should turn repeated convert decisions into one coherent campaign instead of opening multiple fronts.

executor_contract.expand: neutral land or neutral boat only
executor_contract.consolidate: build or upgrade existing territory only
executor_contract.convert: physical force only; choose a safe rival locally and continue that rival while a legal physical action remains

authorized_next_action: Implement, test, and locally qualify the intent-only planner contract. No upload, hosted request, submission, membership change, or champion change is authorized by this preregistration alone.
